packageRules.description: Merge anything that is not a major once its checks pass. One pull request a day rather than one per package: they all merge unattended anyway, and every extra pull request is another one to rebase when a sibling lands.
Every major update is a pull request to review, whatever the package — a major is where behavior changes, and this repo publishes on merge to main

A new .NET release bumps the Microsoft and System packages in lock step with the framework, so their majors arrive as one pull request rather than several. Their minor and patch releases follow the framework too and merge above.
